recommendations.title: Immediate Relaunch of July Creative
recommendations.detail: Since there are 0 active campaigns, immediately relaunch a campaign using the 'JULY ADS 2026' creative. This asset achieved a 4.33% CTR, indicating strong market resonance despite high costs. Use this as the baseline for the new flight.

recommendations.title: Broaden Audience to Combat $363 CPM
recommendations.detail: The CPM is extremely high ($363.62). For the relaunch, move away from narrow interest-based targeting or small lookalikes. Use a 'Broad' targeting strategy (15-25 mile radius, age 25+, no interests) to allow Meta's algorithm to find cheaper inventory and lower the CPM to a projected $20-$40 range.

recommendations.title: Switch Objective to Engagement/Leads
recommendations.detail: The top campaign used the 'OUTCOME_SALES' objective. For Messenger-focused ads, switch to 'OUTCOME_ENGAGEMENT' or 'OUTCOME_LEADS' (Messenger). This typically reduces the barrier to entry and can significantly lower the $91.40 cost per message by optimizing for the conversation start rather than a final sale conversion.

recommendations.title: Implement Messaging Leads Template
recommendations.detail: To improve the quality of the $91 messages, implement a 'Messenger Lead Form' (automated questions) to pre-qualify buyers on credit, trade-in status, or car model interest before a human salesperson takes over.

alerts.message: Zero Active Campaigns: The account currently has no spend and no active ads, resulting in a total loss of digital lead flow for the dealership.

Extreme CPM Anomaly: The CPM of $363.62 is roughly 10x-15x higher than the automotive industry average. This indicates a setup error, an extremely restricted audience, or bidding against a very high-value conversion event.
High Cost Per Message: At $91.40 per message, the current acquisition cost is likely exceeding the dealership's target CPA for initial contact.
